defs.def: Saturday and Sunday 星期六和星期日；周末

ex.s: *Bookstore/mailroom(9:00-12:00 at weekends)
If anyone had told me three years ago that I would be spending most of my weekends camping.
ex.t: 如果三年前有人告诉我，我会把大部分周末花在露营上。

ex.s: Keep your sleep/wake schedule on weekends.
ex.t: 保持周末的睡眠/唤醒作息。

ex.s: But compensating on the weekends actually feeds into your sleepiness the following week, a recent study found.
ex.t: 但最近的一项研究发现，在周末补觉实际上会让你下一周更困。

ex.s: This weekend is her 45th birthday.
ex.t: 这个周末是她45岁的生日。

ex.s: Student A wants to go to a comedy show this weekend.
ex.t: 学生A想这个周末去看一场喜剧表演。

ex.s: If you’re willing to drive a little further, the Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles promises luxurious rooms and extensive leisure facilities — perfect for turning a game day into a great weekend escape.
ex.t: 如果你愿意开得稍远一点，洛杉矶丽思卡尔顿酒店承诺提供豪华客房和丰富的休闲设施——非常适合把比赛日变成一次很棒的周末出游。

ex.s: They are scheduled for the weekend.
ex.t: 它们都安排在周末。

ex.s: What will Jack probably do this weekend?
ex.t: 杰克这个周末可能会做什么？

ex.s: What did Clara do at the weekend?
ex.t: 克拉拉周末做了什么？

ex.s: For example, the experience of walking along the edge of water might be satisfying for a young professional on a weekend hike in the park.
ex.t: 例如，沿水边行走的体验可能让一位在公园周末徒步的年轻职场人士感到满足。

ex.s: What does the man want to do on the weekend?
ex.t: 这位男士周末想做什么？

ex.s: Put off watching your favorite show until the weekend or wait 10 extra minutes before going for that cake.
ex.t: 将您最喜爱的节目推迟到周末观看，或额外等待10分钟后再去吃蛋糕。

ex.s: What does the man want to do on the weekend?
ex.t: 这位男士周末想做什么？

ex.s: To cancel a weekend trip.
ex.t: 为了取消周末旅行。

ex.s: Henry Tyler made the catch of the year on the weekend.
ex.t: Henry Tyler上周末接住了年度最佳球。

ex.s: Every weekend this is “Wales” premier comedy club where having a great time is the order for both audiences and comedy stars alike.
ex.t: 每个周末这里都是"威尔士"顶级喜剧俱乐部，观众和喜剧明星都能在这里度过美好时光。

ex.s: What will Jim probably do this weekend?
ex.t: Amanda为什么想学弹吉他？

ex.s: To cancel a weekend trip.
ex.t: 为了取消周末旅行。

ex.s: My faith in human nature has never been so great as it was last weekend after our family get-together in the town of Vail.
ex.t: 我对人性的信心从未像上周末在韦尔镇家庭聚会后那样强烈。

ex.s: Where did the woman go at the weekend?
ex.t: 那位女士周末去了哪里？

ex.s: How did the man spend his weekend?
ex.t: 那位男士是如何度过周末的？

ex.s: During the long trip home, following a weekend of hunting.
ex.t: 在一次打猎的周末之后，在漫长的回家途中。

ex.s: Over the weekend， he worked through the piles of handmade cards at his house． One card from a student stood out to him． It read： "Mr． Haze，you are my sunshine．"
ex.t: 整个周末，他在家翻看那一堆手写卡片。一张学生的卡片让他眼前一亮。上面写着：“黑兹先生，你是我的阳光。”

ex.s: The team transforms the family’s long weekend of celebration with less expensive but still tasty recipes.
ex.t: 团队用价格更低但依然美味的食谱改变了这个家庭漫长的周末庆祝活动。
